question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A non-professional who is inept at a particular activity
solution:
The correct answer is:** Amateur**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• 1) **Expert -** a person who is very knowledgeable or skilled in a particular area
 
• 2) **Amateur -** a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis
 
• 3)** Director -** a person who is in charge of an organization or activity
 
• 4) **Fatalist -** a person who believes that events are predetermined and therefore inevitable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Amateur**.
